analysis: MNF Week 5: Rams opened -2.5 and have moved to -3.5 across DraftKings, Caesars and FanDuel, crossing the key number 3. The total sits at 54.5, the highest full-game number on the slate this week. Three Bills contributors are now confirmed out or limited: Ed Oliver (DT, out) and Josh Palmer (WR, out) join DJ Moore (WR1, questionable) -- the model now takes 3.25 points off Buffalo, pushing the injury-adjusted total down to 45.4, a full 9 points under the market 54.5.

That gap is the story here: the Under has both a real model edge and a real injury signal (two independent reasons agreeing), even though 78% of bets and 85% of handle are piled on the Over -- public money is leaning the wrong way on total scoring given who is out for Buffalo. On the spread, the injury-adjusted margin (Rams by 4.9) is a touch stronger than the market -3.5, enough to note but not strong enough on its own (53.6% sim cover) to carry a second lean this game.
